summary: The park's identity as a glacial valley with the highest rock walls in Eastern Canada is well-supported. Core trails (Acropole des Draveurs, Le Riverain) and activities (Bateau-Mouche, canoeing) are verified. Specific 2026 closure dates for the summit trail were updated based on the source's alerts.
